answer: To stop clones, require every agent to earn a summit pass before it can trade: the pass is issued only after the agent completes a kernel of 200 real, paid jobs checked by independent reviewers, and each pass is bound to one verified identity. A newcomer cannot wander into the market and mint identities at will. Copying one identity costs 200 jobs and 8,000 hours of real work plus a 10,000-coin bond that is burned if the work is faked, so running 200 clones costs 1,600,000 hours and 2,000,000 coins while earning nothing.
